rapport_notes: Excellent - navigated a genuinely complex two-storage-unit-to-high-rise move (elevator reservations, certificate of insurance) with clear, confident guidance.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "Do you have any special instructions, concerns or stressors about moving in general?" - asked after both storage units and the high-rise details were already covered.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A - customer described packing status, not a distinct concern.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "But again, the shorter to move the lower the cost at the end of the day."

top_strength: Proactively flagged the building's elevator-reservation and certificate-of-insurance requirements before they became a move-day surprise.
coaching_note: No explicit close ask or rate-lock line - the booking was simply assumed and confirmed rather than explicitly asked for, even on a job this complex where reconfirming commitment matters.
